description: Verifies that the adaptive integrator preserves the four-velocity normalization: a circular Schwarzschild orbit over fifty thousand steps keeps the invariant residual below 1e-11, and a radial free fall through the horizon in Painleve-Gullstrand coordinates stays below 1e-10.

checks.label: every adaptive step of the circular orbit succeeds
the normalization residual of the circular orbit stays below 1e-11
every adaptive step of the infall succeeds
the infalling particle crosses the horizon
the normalization residual of the infall stays below 1e-10
